test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A and B complete a work in 2 days. If A alone can do it in 4 days then, B alone can do 19-times of the same work in ______________(days).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Days for B alone = (**A × Combined**) ÷ (**A − Combined**) = (4 × 2) ÷ (4 − 2) = 4 days.

For 19-times the work, **B** takes = 19 × 4 = 76 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 76 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (A + B) can do work in 2 days, A can do work in 4 days.

**Formula:** Total Work = LCM of days; Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Days.

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**

 A + B
 2
 4 units
 4 ÷ 2 = 2

 A
 4
 4 ÷ 4 = 1

⇒ Efficiency of **B** = Efficiency of (A + B) − Efficiency of A

⇒ Efficiency of **B** = 2 − 1 = 1 unit/day

⇒ Time for **B** to do 1-time work = 4 ÷ 1 = 4 days

⇒ Time for **B** to do 19-times work = 19 × 4 = 76 days

**∴ The correct answer is 76 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Efficiency Relation

Time is inversely proportional to efficiency. If work increases by **n-times**, the time required at the same efficiency also increases by **n-times**.

Combined Work Formula

If A takes 'x' days and B takes 'y' days, together they take (x × y) ÷ (x + y) days to complete the work.

Pipes and Cisterns

This logic applies to **inlet pipes**. If an outlet pipe is present, its efficiency is taken as **negative**.</p
